quests.instruction: Touch the body part that helps you bite into a sandwich. It is also the one that a dentist checks to keep healthy and strong, but it is NOT your eyelids!
quests.question: Teeth
quests.hint: Think about this: They are hard, white, and live inside your mouth.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Teeth help you bite and chew your food!
quests.funFact: Brushing twice a day keeps your teeth strong and healthy.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that sits above your eyebrows and below your hair. It is also the one that wrinkles up when you feel confused, but it is NOT your tongue!
quests.question: Forehead
quests.hint: Hint: It gets wrinkly when you look puzzled.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Forehead is the flat part of your face above your eyebrows!
quests.funFact: Your forehead protects the front part of your skull underneath.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that bends right where your foot meets your leg. It is also the one where you might wear a fun pair of socks, but it is NOT your heels!
quests.question: Ankles
quests.hint: Hint: You bend these when you point your toes.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Ankles connect your feet to your legs and help you balance!
quests.funFact: You use your ankles every time you jump or hop.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that helps you smell sweet flowers. It is also the one that sneezes loudly when it feels tickly, but it is NOT your cheeks!
quests.question: Nose
quests.hint: Think about this: You breathe air in and out through it.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Nose helps you smell and breathe in fresh air!
quests.funFact: Everybody's nose is a little bit different, just like a fingerprint.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that smiles when you feel happy. It is also the one we use to say hello to a friend, but it is NOT your jaw!
quests.question: Mouth
quests.hint: Think about this: Your teeth and tongue live inside it.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Mouth helps you eat, talk, and smile!
quests.funFact: Your mouth makes spit that helps you chew and swallow food.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found attached to your torso: two that grip and two that carry you. It is NOT your backbone!
quests.question: Limbs
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is the name for your arms AND legs together!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Limbs are your arms and legs, working together as a team!
quests.funFact: Limbs is the special name for your arms and legs all together!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that gets covered up by a t-shirt. It is NOT your back!
quests.question: Torso
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is the middle of your body!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Torso is the name for the middle of your body, made up of your chest, back, and tummy!
quests.funFact: Your torso is the name for your chest, tummy, and back all together!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that grows along the edge of your eyelids. It is also the one you blink to keep dust out of your eyes, but it is NOT your teeth!
quests.question: Eyelashes
quests.hint: Hint: They help keep dust out of your eyes.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Eyelashes grow along your eyelids and help keep dust out of your eyes!
quests.funFact: Eyelashes grow, fall out, and grow back again on their own.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that bends right in the middle of your leg. It is also the one you bend when you sit criss-cross on the floor, but it is NOT your ankles!
quests.question: Knees
quests.hint: Hint: They are between your hip and your ankle.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Knees are the bendy joints in the middle of your legs!
quests.funFact: A small round bone called the kneecap protects the front of each knee.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that wears cozy socks and shoes. It is also the one you stomp on the ground when you feel excited, but it is NOT your heels!
quests.question: Feet
quests.hint: Think about this: They are found at the end of your legs.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Feet help you stand, walk, and run!
quests.funFact: Feet have their own tiny muscles that help you stand still.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you pat after running a fast race -- but it is not your toenails!
quests.question: Thighs
quests.hint: They are between your hip and your knee.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Thighs are the top part of your leg, between your hip and your knee!
quests.funFact: Your thighs help you pedal a bike and climb up stairs.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you raise up high when you feel surprised. It is also the one that sits right above each of your eyes, but it is NOT your hair!
quests.question: Eyebrows
quests.hint: Hint: They are small, thin lines of hair above your eyes.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Eyebrows sit above your eyes and help keep sweat and rain out of them!
quests.funFact: Each eyebrow has its own special curved shape.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that lets you watch your favorite cartoon. It is also the one you close tight when you play hide and seek, but it is NOT your mouth!
quests.question: Eyes
quests.hint: Think about this: Close these and everything turns dark.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Eyes help you see everything around you, like colors and shapes!
quests.funFact: Your eyes start working before you are even born!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you rest your hands on when you stand like a superhero -- but it is not your waist!
quests.question: Hips
quests.hint: They are below your waist.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Hips are where your legs connect to your body, and help your legs swing!
quests.funFact: Hips let your legs swing forward, backward, and side to side.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that gets stronger the more you run, jump, and play. It is also the one you flex to show off your strength, like a superhero, but it is NOT your joints!
quests.question: Muscles
quests.hint: They help every part of your body move!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Muscles are under your skin and squeeze together to help your body move!
quests.funFact: Your body has more than six hundred muscles working together!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you might feel moving when you talk out loud -- but it is not your eyebrows!
quests.question: Jaw
quests.hint: Your bottom teeth are held inside it.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Jaw moves up and down to help you chew and talk!
quests.funFact: Your jaw moves every time you talk, chew, or yawn.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part found inside your head, just under your skin and hair, not your muscles!
quests.question: Skull
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It gives your head its round shape.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Skull is the hard bone inside your head that protects your brain!
quests.funFact: Your skull is actually made of several bones joined together.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found at the very end of your toes -- but it is not your shins!
quests.question: Toenails
quests.hint: You trim these to keep them short too.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Toenails are the hard part that grows at the tip of each toe and protects it!
quests.funFact: Toenails protect your toes when you take every step.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found at the very end of your fingers -- but it is not your elbows!
quests.question: Fingernails
quests.hint: You trim these to keep them short.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Fingernails are the hard part that grows at the tip of each finger and protects it!
quests.funFact: Fingernails help protect the sensitive tips of your fingers.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that helps you keep your balance when you stand on one foot. It is also the one you use to feel cool sand at the beach, but it is NOT your legs!
quests.question: Toes
quests.hint: Think about this: They are found at the end of your feet.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Toes help you balance and push off the ground when you walk!
quests.funFact: Toes help push you forward every time you take a step.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that protects your heart and lungs, which sit safely inside it, not your bones!
quests.question: Ribs
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You can feel them if you press gently on your chest.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Ribs curve around your chest like a cage and protect your heart and lungs!
quests.funFact: Ribs keep your heart and lungs safe from bumps.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that sits just above each of your eyes and covers them like tiny curtains. It is also the one that protects your eyes from bright sunshine and dust, but it is NOT your jaw!
quests.question: Eyelids
quests.hint: They close every time you blink!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Eyelids cover your eyes like tiny curtains and close every time you blink!
quests.funFact: Your eyelids blink automatically to keep your eyes clean and safe!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you wrap a hula hoop around when you play -- but it is not your throat!
quests.question: Waist
quests.hint: It is between your chest and your hips.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Waist is the middle part of your body, between your chest and your hips!
quests.funFact: A hula hoop spins right around this part of your body.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part found inside your chest, on either side of your heart, not your skeleton!
quests.question: Lungs
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You use these to blow out candles.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Lungs fill up with air when you breathe and let you blow things up!
quests.funFact: Deep breaths fill your lungs with plenty of fresh air.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that gets tickled if someone touches it gently -- but it is not your ankles!
quests.question: Soles
quests.hint: They touch the inside of your shoes.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Soles are the bottom of your feet that touch the ground!
quests.funFact: Your soles help you feel if the ground is smooth, bumpy, hot, or cold.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found right in the center of your tummy. It is also the one that can be an 'innie' or an 'outie', but it is NOT your neck!
quests.question: Belly Button
quests.hint: It is the little dot in the middle of your tummy!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Belly Button is the little dot in the middle of your tummy that everybody has!
quests.funFact: Everybody has a belly button, and everybody's looks a little different!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found on the front of your lower leg, just below your knee. It is also the one that has a hard bone right under a thin layer of skin, but it is NOT your kneecap!
quests.question: Shins
quests.hint: They are the front of your lower legs!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Shins are the front of your lower leg, where the bone sits close to your skin!
quests.funFact: The bone in your shin is one of the strongest bones in your body!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part where the air goes in and out every time you breathe. It is also the one found at the tip of your nose, one on each side, but it is NOT your eyes!
quests.question: Nostrils
quests.hint: They are the two little holes in your nose!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Nostrils are the two small openings in your nose that air moves through!
quests.funFact: You actually breathe more through one nostril at a time, and they take turns!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that bends right where your hand meets your arm. It is also the one where you might wear a cozy bracelet or watch, but it is NOT your hands!
quests.question: Wrists
quests.hint: Hint: You bend these to wave your hand.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Wrists connect your hands to your arms and let your hands turn and wave!
quests.funFact: You use your wrists every time you turn a doorknob.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that helps you jump up high off the ground -- but it is not your knees!
quests.question: Calves
quests.hint: They are between your knee and your ankle.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Calves are the back of your lower leg, between your knee and your ankle!
quests.funFact: Calves are the back part of your leg, below your knee.
